description: This file defines several custom Flutter widget classes, including visual and UI components such as NeonGlow, SigmaGradientBackground, SigmaCard, SigmaNeonButton, and SectionHeader, each providing a styled or functional widget for a Flutter app.

classes.name: NeonGlow
classes.description: A widget that applies a neon glow effect around its child using box shadows.

classes.name: SigmaGradientBackground
classes.description: A widget that provides a gradient background with theme-based primary and secondary colors.

classes.name: SigmaCard
classes.description: A styled card widget that optionally supports tap interactions with a ripple effect.

classes.name: SigmaNeonButton
classes.description: A button widget with a neon glow effect, supporting an icon and label.

classes.name: SectionHeader
classes.description: A widget displaying a section title with optional subtitle and trailing widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for each widget class.
